'''Forestry''' is a tier two [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Clear Forest]] ability, which removes a forest and gives the player one star, and the [[Lumber Hut]], a [[building]] that costs 3 stars and produces one [[population]]. 

For the [[∑∫ỹriȱŋ]] tribe, Forestry unlocks the [[Sanctuary]], a building that produces one star for each adjacent wild animal, and the Lumber Hut.
